s: Which Goods and Services Tax (GST) Council meeting was held on 22nd June 2024 at New Delhi?
x: The 53rd GST Council meeting was held on 22 June 2024 in New Delhi under Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman (phased biometric Aadhaar authentication for registration, waiver of interest and penalty on Section 73 demands). The 54th met on 9 September 2024 in New Delhi and the 55th on 21 December 2024 at Jaisalmer; the 52nd was in October 2023.
